goal: Extract the cohesive submission and exclusion configuration API from JPlagOptions to further reduce its public API size and separate input-path concerns from comparison concerns.

ops.details: Extract submissionDirectories, oldSubmissionDirectories, baseCodeSubmissionName, exclusionFileName, excludedFiles, subdirectoryName, getBaseCodeSubmissionName(), getExcludedFiles(), getExclusionFileName(), getSubmissionDirectories(), getOldSubmissionDirectories(), getSubdirectoryName(), hasBaseCode(), setBaseCodeSubmissionName(String), setExcludedFiles(Set<String>), setExclusionFileName(String), setSubmissionDirectories(List<String>), setOldSubmissionDirectories(List<String>), and setSubdirectoryName(String) into JPlagSubmissionOptions in the same package. Preserve the existing null, empty-string, and file-separator handling behavior.

Update callers to use JPlagSubmissionOptions for submission directories, old submission directories, base-code selection, excluded files, exclusion file name, and subdirectory selection. Preserve the existing JPlagOptions construction flow and compatibility behavior while delegating or redirecting access to the extracted object.
